name: VMA Applications
query:
SELECT
    UPPER(employee_name) as "Employee:Data:150",
    phone_number AS "Phone No:Data:120",
    vehicle_number AS "Vehicle No:Data:120",
    vehicle_registration_date AS "Vehicle Registration Date:Date:120",
    road_worthiness_expiry_date AS "Road Worthiness Expiry Date:Date:120",
    vehicle_insurance_expiry_date AS "Insurance Expiry Date:Date:120",
    drivers_licence_expiry_date AS "Driver's Licence Expiry Date:Date:120",
    bank_name AS "Bank:Data:150",
    branch_name AS "Branch:Data:150",
    bank_account_type AS "A/C Type:Data:80",
    account_number AS "A/C No:Data:100",
    creation AS "Submission Date:Datetime:180"
FROM 
    `tabVehicle Maintenance Allowance`
WHERE
    (%(creation_start)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) >= %(creation_start)s)
    AND (%(creation_end)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) <= %(creation_end)s)
    AND (%(road_worthiness_expiry_date_start)s IS NULL OR road_worthiness_expiry_date >= %(road_worthiness_expiry_date_start)s)
    AND (%(road_worthiness_expiry_date_end)s IS NULL OR road_worthiness_expiry_date <= %(road_worthiness_expiry_date_end)s)
ORDER BY creation DESC
